## CLAIM claim:33a33396a17d4175-52ea70f5124a7a46
Hilbert 空间允许 Fourier 级数：$\{e^{inx}\}_{n=-\infty}^\infty$ 是 $L^2[-\pi,\pi]$ 中的一组正交基。
Conditions: none
Validity: SUPPORTED

## CLAIM claim:7e02712717a02820-2c66480c74ccfebd

Conditions: none
Validity: SUPPORTED

## CLAIM claim:7e02712717a02820-67b8de7721d103d9

Validity: SUPPORTED
